subject: Mythology
title: Beowulf: The Monster Slayer
description: Learn Beowulf: The Monster Slayer in one minute.

hook.text: Beowulf sailed to Denmark to fight Grendel, a monster that had been devouring warriors for twelve years.

buildup.text: No weapon could pierce Grendel's hide, so Beowulf fought him bare-handed in a darkened mead hall.

discovery.text: He ripped Grendel's arm from its socket. The monster fled bleeding into the swamp and died there.

twist.text: Grendel's mother attacked for revenge. Beowulf dove into her underwater lair and killed her with a giant's sword.

climax.text: Decades later, as an old king, Beowulf died killing one last dragon — proving heroes never truly retire.

punchline.text: He spent his life fighting monsters and died doing it.

quiz.question: How did Beowulf defeat Grendel?
options: He used a magical sword forged by elves
He fought bare-handed and ripped off Grendel's arm
He set a trap using fire and iron chains
